profile.headline: Program Manager at KeyLogic
profile.summary:
Experienced technology leader with over 15 years of success delivering enterprise software solutions for federal agencies including the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) and NASA. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage programs, and drive innovation in complex environments.

With a strong foundation in software engineering and a deep understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies, I’ve served as a Program Manager, Technical Lead, and Scrum Master, guiding teams through the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and architecture to deployment and support.

I hold a Master’s and Bachelor’s in Computer Science from West Virginia University and maintain certifications including PMP, PMI-ACP, PSM I, and PSD I. My technical expertise spans .NET technologies, SQL Server, JavaScript, and DevExpress, with a focus on building scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications.

Core Strengths:
• Program & Project Management
• Agile/Scrum Leadership
• Full-Stack Software Development
• Stakeholder Engagement
• Federal IT Compliance
• Team Building & Mentorship
• Technical Strategy & Roadmapping

positions.title: Program Manager
positions.description:
As Program Manager, I lead a 35+ person software development organization supporting multiple agile teams delivering enterprise solutions for the U.S. Department of Energy, including NETL and DOE Headquarters. I oversee strategic planning, execution, and delivery of complex software programs, ensuring alignment with federal mission objectives and customer priorities.

Key Responsibilities:
• Manage cross-functional agile teams including developers, analysts, and testers
• Serve as primary liaison for DOE stakeholders, ensuring transparency and satisfaction
• Oversee program budgets, resource planning, and contract deliverables
• Ensure compliance with federal IT policies and cybersecurity standards
• Implement Agile/Scrum practices to drive continuous improvement and delivery
• Develop program roadmaps, KPIs, and risk mitigation strategies
• Prepare executive briefings, technical documentation, and performance reports

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As Technical Lead and Scrum Master, I led a high-performing agile development team responsible for delivering a custom-built enterprise project management application for the U.S. Department of Energy. Built on ASP.NET MVC, DevExpress, and SQL Server, the application was selected over commercial alternatives and has seen rapid adoption and expansion across the agency.

In this role, I provided both technical leadership and hands-on development, guiding the team through sprint planning, execution, and delivery in a tightly integrated environment with business analysts and stakeholders. I ensured adherence to CMMI Level 3 processes, conducted code reviews, mentored junior developers, and collaborated with IT operations to manage infrastructure needs.

Key Responsibilities: • Led day-to-day operations of the software development team
• Served as Scrum Master, facilitating agile ceremonies and removing impediments
• Contributed as a senior full-stack developer
• Mentored junior developers and conducted code quality reviews
• Ensured compliance with corporate and federal standards
• Collaborated with analysts on requirements, UI/UX design, and data validation
• Interfaced with DOE stakeholders for planning, updates, and feedback
• Developed estimates and proposals for new initiatives
• Performed supervisory duties including performance evaluations

Technologies Used: ASP.NET, MVC, C#, SQL Server, Entity Spaces, JavaScript, jQuery, Visual Studio

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on-site at NASA’s IV&V facility supporting the Magnetospheric Multiscale (MMS) Mission, performing independent verification and validation (IV&V) of flight software to ensure mission safety and reliability.

Key Responsibilities:
• Conducted validation analysis of software requirements and test specifications
• Performed verification analysis of software design, implementation, and test results
• Utilized static code analysis tools including Flexelint, Klocwork, and CodeSonar
• Developed automation tools, scripts, and Excel macros to improve team productivity
• Authored formal reports documenting findings, analysis results, and risk assessments
• Participated in engineering peer reviews, code walkthroughs, and milestone meetings
• Supported major project reviews including Preliminary and Critical Design Reviews

Recognized for high-impact contributions, including multiple Certificates of Appreciation and a formal letter of recognition from the MMS IV&V Project Manager.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Supported undergraduate and senior-level computer science courses as a Graduate Teaching Assistant, providing instruction, mentorship, and technical guidance to students in both classroom and lab settings.

Key Responsibilities:
• Led lab sessions and delivered lectures for introductory and senior-level courses, including Operating Systems
• Guided students through a semester-long operating system development project
• Assisted with debugging, project reviews, and resolving group collaboration issues
• Graded assignments, managed exams, and provided academic support
• Fostered a collaborative learning environment and mentored students on technical concepts and best practices

positions.title: End User Services Intern
positions.description:
Supported enterprise IT operations through a combination of technical support, process automation, and web development initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:
• Designed and implemented intranet web pages, including a web-based operating system platform for internal information sharing
• Automated IT processes using custom-built VBScript tools and Excel macros
• Provided end-user support both on-site and via the IT Service Center (call center)
• Performed PC and server imaging, setup, and installation
• Troubleshot hardware and software issues across a range of systems and users
